summary: Charts on the map with a search bar, UAE charts, IVAO traffic, airport weather, FAA chart layers and a cleaner World map.
releaseNotes: Charts on the map: a new Charts button in Map settings → Layers opens one panel with a search bar. Pick a STAR, SID or approach and it is laid over the map in the right place, with an opacity slider.
UAE charts: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Al Maktoum charts from the GCAA, shown inside Stratos.
IVAO traffic: choose IVAO as the traffic source to see live IVAO pilots on the map.
Airport weather layer: every reporting station in view, coloured by flight category, with wind, visibility, ceiling and temperature as you zoom in.
US chart layers: FAA Sectional, Terminal, IFR Low and IFR High charts as map layers.
The desktop app can now open charts outside the US.
Phone mode: the EFB dock no longer covers the app icons, Settings titles use the full width, and the Flight Plan chart card no longer hides half the map.
The World map has a cleaner chart style in night and day: muted water, plain land, crisp coastlines, quiet borders and a light grid.
